name: 1.2 Blog Research -> write to Google Sheet

mapper.input:
Can you research and get me up to {{69.blogs_per_sentence}} top ranking blogs in Google when a consumer searches "{{74.value}}" . Rank them by estimated traffic (monthly visits).

Exclude all large mainstream outlets beyond top tier media publications like Vogue, Marie Claire, or Byrdie. I only want smaller independent blogs and only the ones with the most traffic.

I want to only pull blogs that have been active in the last year. Make sure to add author of blog which can be only first and last name of author, name of blog, article url and url domain.
(example: author: John Smith, blog name: Sample Blog,	url: https://sampleblog.com/best-aesthetic-cookware/, domain: sampleblog.com)

DO NOT ask any other questions, just provide the answer best as you can.
DO NOT write notes, explanations, limitations, etc.
